assessment_objectives.objective: Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) are decommissioned so that data is transitioned to new systems or archived in accordance with applicable organizational standards, as well as statutory, regulatory and contractual obligations.

hard drives from decommissioned Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) are either destroyed or erased in accordance with applicable organizational standards, as well as statutory, regulatory and contractual obligations.
